findings.title: Potential Hardcoded Secret Detected
findings.description: Potential secret material was detected in resource 'aws_db_instance.main'.
findings.recommendation: Remove secrets from Terraform configuration and use AWS Secrets Manager, SSM Parameter Store, or another secure secret-management solution.

findings.title: IAM Permission Applies to All Resources
findings.description: Resource 'aws_iam_role_policy.web_policy' contains an IAM permission targeting all resources.
findings.recommendation: Replace wildcard resource permissions with specific resource ARNs.

findings.title: SSH Port Exposed to Internet
findings.description: Resource 'aws_security_group.web' allows public ingress on port 22.
findings.recommendation: Restrict SSH access to specific trusted IP CIDRs or use AWS SSM.

findings.title: Unrestricted Outbound Network Traffic
findings.description: Resource 'aws_security_group.web' allows unrestricted outbound traffic to the internet.
findings.recommendation: Restrict outbound traffic to only the destinations and protocols required by the workload.
